messages:
laura_cs: heads-up: FinShare reported a regression — rerank endpoint returning near-zero / effectively zeroed scores for identical inputs since the runtime transform landed last night. customer says same payload yields very different ranks, most scores are 0.0 or ~1e-4. request id examples: req-0a1b2c, req-0a1b2d. impact: customer-visible ranking changes, some results flattened.

jen_support: yikes. thanks for flagging. is this reproducible on our side? can you paste a minimal curl + response? also what model/version + runtime?

laura_cs: repro is easy — same query repeated 10x -> different score distribution, see curl below. model: rerank-v2.1, runtime: inference-runtime-transform-2026-03-16.

laura_cs: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"query":"buy leather shoes","candidates":["brown shoe","black shoe","red shoe"],"top_k":3}'

Response: {"request_id":"req-0a1b2c","scores":[0.0,0.0,0.0],"ranks":[1,2,3]}

Next call (same payload): {"request_id":"req-0a1b2d","scores":[0.00012,0.00011,0.00009],"ranks":[1,2,3]}```

mike_infra: deploybot shows the runtime-transform patch rolled to canary at 2351111000, ~30% traffic.

deploybot: user-deploy runtime-transform v2026-03-16 rolled to canary (30%) at 2351111000 by ops_release_bot.

aj_research: initial hypothesis: transform applies extra logit normalization / scaling that can underflow to zero when logits are small, and combined with float16 paths in the runtime it clamps. Could be float precision + clamp threshold.

sophie_prod: FinShare flagged it as Sev2 (rank quality impact). they see ~2% of their rerank calls showing collapsed scores; their eval set shows big MRR drop for affected inputs. we should prioritize.

jen_support: laura can you run the debug endpoint with debug=true and attach the raw logits + softmax output? also need the exact request_id and timestamp windows so we can correlate logs.

laura_cs: ran debug on req-0a1b2c and req-0a1b2d, pasted anonymized snippet: ```{"request_id":"req-0a1b2c","raw_logits":[-12.3,-12.4,-12.5],"post_transform_logits":[-inf,-inf,-inf],"softmax":[0,0,0]}```

laura_cs: and for req-0a1b2d: ```{"request_id":"req-0a1b2d","raw_logits":[-8.2,-8.3,-8.4],"post_transform_logits":[-12.7,-12.8,-12.9],"softmax":[0.00012,0.00011,0.00009]}```

aj_research: that matches float clamp + normalization: transform is doing a logit shift by -logsumexp(offset) where offset computed incorrectly when inputs hit a branch (empty candidate metadata). In one path offset becomes large positive -> post_transform_logits -> -inf when subtracting in float16.

mike_infra: quick mitigation: disable the new transform flag for canary and scaleback to 0% while we patch. I'll stage a rollback toggle.

deploybot: rollback toggle scheduled: runtime-transform -> canary 30% -> 0% at 2351112400 (pending approval).

jen_support: to help root cause/patch: aj, can you provide a small unit test + failing input so infra can run in CI? include seed to reproduce float path.

aj_research: yes. repro script (python): ```# repro snippet
inputs = ["small logits path","slightly larger logits"]
def apply_transform(logits):
    # simplified pseudo-transform to reproduce underflow
    scale = compute_scale_from_metadata(logits)  # bug: returns huge value for empty metadata
    logits = logits - scale
    return softmax(to_float16(logits))
```

aj_research: I'll attach a proper unit test to the model repo and a PR to add clamp guards (floor at -1e4 before to_float16) and fix the compute_scale path.

laura_cs: customer notified (FinShare PM) that we're investigating and will roll back for canary if needed. they asked for ETA.

sophie_prod: estimate: infra rollback ~15-30m once approved; patch + deploy ~2-4 hours for full test and canary; if QA passes we can re-enable. recommend we revert canary immediately.

jen_support: I'll open an incident ticket and mark communications: outbound -> FinShare, internal -> eng + support channel. please add repro logs to the ticket.

laura_cs: incident created: INC-23511. added logs/requests and tagged FinShare SLA.

mike_infra: rolled canary back to 0% (deploybot shows complete). monitoring: watch for rerank score distributions.

deploybot: runtime-transform canary scaled to 0% at 2351112450.

laura_cs: quick verification after rollback: re-ran same payload, scores stable and non-zero. e.g., req-0a1b2e -> {"scores":[0.0021,0.0019,0.0012]}.

aj_research: will cut PR for clamp + metadata guard, request review from infra. I'll also add a new unit test exercising empty-metadata branch.

jen_support: thanks everyone. next steps: aj PR + infra deploy to staging, QA check on FinShare's sample set, then controlled canary. update incident with timeline.

laura_cs: marking this thread resolved for customer communications; will update when PR merged. :thumbsup:
